title: Oops! When You Drink & Drive And Land In A House…
description:
On December 2nd, 2022, at around 2:00 am, Chillicothe Police Department responded to a vehicle that had crashed into the front of a residence. When officers arrived, the resident told officers what had happened and gave them a suspect description of a “heavy set” male with a beard. 

The suspect was charged with operating a vehicle while impaired and failure to control & leaving the scene of the crash.
